landing_text.landsutilities.landsutiliti: A guide on the various contraptions that Land's Utilities offers
message.landsutilities.empty_remote_cont: Remote control has no linked blocks!
message.landsutilities.not_remote_contro: No remote control in either hand!
message.landsutilities.redstone_wand.add: Block at %s is now under special redstone handling: %s
message.landsutilities.redstone_wand.rem: Block at %s is no longer under special redstone handling
message.landsutilities.remote_block_blac: Block is blacklisted from working with the Remote Control
message.landsutilities.renamed_link: Renamed remote control link name to %s
tooltip.landsutilities.auto_anvil: Just like a vanilla anvil but runs automatically using fluid experience from any mod. Note: Do NOT pipe fluid experience directly into the anvil; instead pipe it into an adjacent tank in the configured direction (by default, above the anvil).
tooltip.landsutilities.facade_wand: Disguise any block as another (any block with a standard model should work). Shift-right-click on a block to set the block you want to disguise stuff as. Right-click on a block to disguise it as the set block, or again to remove the disguise.
tooltip.landsutilities.redstone_wand: Shift-scroll to cycle between modes; shift-right-click to make a block act like a redstone block/lever/button
tooltip.landsutilities.remote_control: Allows remotely accessing menus from blocks. See Patchouli docs
